searchText: So, I have 5 Validators running now for over a month at Medalla. Why is Att. Effectiviness varying between 95% and 40% according to Beaconchain? Details on the website. Goerli is down/stalled. <@!557201004060213248> are you aware? Goerli seems to be moving again now
